newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 661 retail money market mutual funds rose $6.10 billion to $593.18 billion in the week ended Oct. 9, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 405 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $4.71 billion to $483.58 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds rose $1.39 billion to $109.59 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 306 institutional money market funds rose $2.66 billion to $271.91 billion. Of these, the 243 taxable money market fund assets grew $3.03 billion to $243.04 billion, and assets of the 63 tax exempt funds fell $371.4 million to $28.88 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $865.09 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended Oct. 2 were revised to $856.33 billion from $856.37 billion.
